decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Use of the commercial unit shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials in respect of the commercial unit have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before the use is commenced.
description: Details submitted pursuant to conditions 5 (forecourt landscaping), 10 (Waste and Recycling) and 11 (Noise insulation) of planning permission 00607/L/P2 dated 03/04/2013 for the variation of condition 2 (approved drawings) of planning permission 00607/L/P1 dated 26/10/2012 for the reconfiguration and refurbishment of former magistrates court to provide restaurant/cafe at ground/lower ground floors, with creation of nine flats over upper and extended second floor levels. Provision of new ramp access to main entrance and new landscaped area to front
